dedupe_keys.name: kraft bleaching wastewater anaerobic treatment ecotoxicity and genotoxicity

description: This deposit reports biological effects of bleaching wastewater before and after treatment in a horizontal anaerobic immobilised-biomass reactor. The research collaborators provide an XLS workbook containing control observations and Allium cepa genetic-toxicity outcomes, alongside ecotoxicity measures. The Data in Brief article locates the experiments in São Paulo, Brazil, and separately identifies a later ozone and ozone/UV post-treatment deposit. Coverage is the documented reactor experiment, not a regional industrial-effluent inventory; calendar sampling dates were not established. Mendeley offers this release free under CC BY 4.0. Laboratory assays and incompletely defined response-index wording in the repository are limitations when relating biological responses to process state variables. Modellers could supplement chemical removal calibration with biological effects in treatment simulations. model-dhi-west-wastewater-treatment-process-modelling is a related resource, but no automatic parameter conversion is documented. The workbook was not downloaded, and this record does not combine the two deposits as if they were interchangeable measurements.
